commissioning.title: EnOcean BLE Auto-Commissioning
commissioning.description:
Activate auto-commissioning on {name}:

1. Hold button 1 for 7 seconds
2. Press button 1 briefly
3. Hold button 1 again for 7 seconds

You have 2 minutes. Retry if needed.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm EnOcean BLE Device
bluetooth_confirm.description:
EnOcean switch with address {mac} was commissioned successfully.

⚠️ Press another button to disable commissioning mode, then click Submit.

user.title: Add EnOcean BLE switch manually
user.description: Enter the text of the QR code on the switch module (for example `30SE215…+Z…+30PPTM215B…`), or its address and 32-digit security key. You can also skip this and simply press a button on the switch: it is then discovered automatically.

data.onboarding: QR code text, or address and security key

data_description.onboarding: The QR code is printed on the switch module under the rocker. Any phone QR scanner shows its text.

progress.waiting_commissioning: Hold button 1 for 7 seconds, then press button 1 briefly, and hold again for 7 seconds.

abort.no_bluetooth_discovery: This setup must start from a discovered Bluetooth device.
abort.not_enocean_prefix: This discovered device does not use the EnOcean BLE MAC prefix (E2:15).

error.commissioning_not_detected: No commissioning telegram was received within 2 minutes. Try again. If it still does not work after multiple attempts, you can try a factory reset. Please read the reset disclaimer in the documentation first.
error.invalid_commissioning: A commissioning telegram was received but could not be validated. Try again. If this keeps failing, review the factory reset disclaimer in the documentation before resetting.
error.invalid_onboarding: No EnOcean address (E2:15:…) and 32-digit key found in the text.

data_description.strict_replay_protection: Write the telegram counter to disk after every button press instead of a few seconds later. Prevents a one-time replay of recorded radio traffic after a crash or power loss, at the cost of a small disk write per click. Only needed if the switch controls locks, doors or similar.

auth_failed.title: {name} can no longer be authenticated
auth_failed.description:
Telegrams from the EnOcean switch **{name}** ({mac}) fail authentication. The switch was most likely factory-reset or re-commissioned by another system, so its security key changed.

Open the [device page]({device_url}), choose **Reconfigure** from the three-dot menu and repeat the commissioning sequence. Automations and entities are kept.
